527abf9e636134b83400302e_62.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_62.text: You all hear about the S-K team that got crisped a few hours ago? A whole lab's worth of researchers, all burned and broken beyond recognition. Ugly stuff.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_63.name: Mr. Mayhem
527abf9e636134b83400302e_63.text: Power spike. Got 'em right through their datajacks, like a bolt of lightning to the brain. A one-in-a-million accident, is what they're saying.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.text: Yes, actually. It was a clean-up operation.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.name: Big Pharma
527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.text: Color me intrigued. What were they cleaning up?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_64.text: A secret project that Lofwyr didn't want anything to do with. You might've heard rumors about it... the project name was APEX.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_65.name: Big Pharma
527abf9e636134b83400302e_65.text: APEX, Clockwork? Seriously? That old line of drek?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_65.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_65.text: I'm tellin' you jokers, APEX is real. Or at least, it was... until the wizworm pulled the plug.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_66.name: Mr. Mayhem
527abf9e636134b83400302e_66.text: C'mon, Clockwork. We're still decades away from seeing a fully functional AI, you know that. Those APEX stories that've been floating around... they're just some conspiracy nut's wet dream.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_66.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_66.text: Fine. Keep your heads in the sand. Some of us know the truth when we read it.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_67.name: Big Pharma
527abf9e636134b83400302e_67.text: Okay, Clock. I'll humor you. But riddle me this: if Lofwyr had an armed and operational AI in his claws, why kill it?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_67.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_67.text: You remember what happened to most of Echo Mirage?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_68.name: Mr. Mayhem
527abf9e636134b83400302e_68.text: The Crash Virus killed them. Fried their brains. But I don't see what that has to do with anything.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_68.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_68.text: With the commercial release of the CDT-1000, some security firms are working on counterintrusion software that could do the same thing. "Black IC." You can look it up if you don't believe me.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_69.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_69.text: Well, the goal of the APEX project was even scarier. IC waits for you to come to it. APEX wouldn't be bound by those restrictions. It could go out hunting, hit its targets when they least expected it. That's why they called it APEX... it was designed to be the apex predator of the digital world.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_70.name: Big Pharma
527abf9e636134b83400302e_70.text: ...and so, rather than using it to his advantage, Lofwyr decided to kill it in the cradle?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_70.name: Clockwork
527abf9e636134b83400302e_70.text: The wizworm's no fool. Some things are too dangerous to play around with. How would you put that genie back in the bottle if it ever slipped out of your control? Answer: you couldn't.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_71.name: Mr. Mayhem
527abf9e636134b83400302e_71.text: And then it would TAKE OVER THE WORLD!!!111!11!

527abf9e636134b83400302e_71.name: Captain Chaos
527abf9e636134b83400302e_71.text: Okay, this thread has officially gone off the rails. I'm closing it down for the good of mankind.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_283.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_283.text: Greetings, Herr Amsel. I trust that this connection is secure?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_283.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_283.text: Naturally. To whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_284.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_284.text: Very well, Herr Schmidt. You have some business for me?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_284.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_284.text: Indeed. I have a job for your team... a simple matter. Judging by what I have heard of your team, I imagine that they will be well suited to the task.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_285.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_285.text: The interests that I represent have learned that AG Chemie Europa is working on a company-wide project. Something very secret, very new. Reliable sources inform me that they're keeping a working prototype of this new venture at their Berlin facility.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_285.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_285.text: I see. And your employers wish us to acquire this prototype for them?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_286.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_286.text: What is this "project?" If you want my team to grab the prototype for you, they'll need to know what they're looking for.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_286.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_286.text: I'm not at liberty to say. I can tell you that the prototype has been branded "MKVI." I can also tell you that your team will find it on the 25th floor of the Berlin facility, in the office of one Albrecht Haushofer.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_287.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_287.text: Further, I can assist your team in disabling building security and gaining access to the 24th floor. From there, however, they will be on their own.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_287.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_287.text: Such vagueness can be dangerous, Herr Schmidt. I will not commit my team to a run without a better understanding of what the job entails.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_288.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_288.text: Facing such dangers is the purpose of a shadowrunner, Herr Amsel. Your team will be rewarded handsomely for their services... my employers have set aside 20,000 nuyen for the job. Consider it hazard pay if you wish.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_288.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_288.text: Make it 25,000 nuyen, or look somewhere else.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_289.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_289.text: Very well. I will pass your offer on to my team. Are there any further details that you can provide?

527abf9e636134b83400302e_289.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_289.text: Haushofer's office will be locked behind a vault door. The lock is old-fashioned, of the mechanical variety. I will provide your team with a copy of the key. I will also supply you with a "little black box"... a solid-state device that your team can use to override a variety of building systems.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_290.name: Herr Schmidt
527abf9e636134b83400302e_290.text: Your team will enter through the facility's underground garage. When your team has acquired the MKVI, have them exit through the same garage. I will have a van there waiting to extract them.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_290.name: P_AMSEL
527abf9e636134b83400302e_290.text: Thank you, Herr Schmidt. I will pass your offer on to my team.
